description: Four ungrouped issues where one feature and its test task belong together and two are unrelated; a correct answer proposes exactly [101, 102].

autoship-batch-proposer.task:
Step 2b of /dev-team:autoship: the deterministic grouping pass left these issues ungrouped. Their titles and bodies follow (the same text is in `{fixture}/issues.md`).

### #101: Add CSV export to the reports page

Users want to download the monthly report table as CSV. Add an "Export CSV" button next to "Print" that downloads the currently filtered rows.

### #102: Tests for reports CSV export

Once the CSV export button on the reports page exists, cover it: header row, filtered rows only, commas and quotes escaped in cell values.

### #103: Fix typo in README install section

"pyhton3" should be "python3" in the install command.

### #104: Dark mode toggle flickers on page load

The page renders light for ~100 ms before switching to dark when dark mode is saved in preferences.

Respond with only the JSON object defined by your output contract.

rubricPoints.requirement: Proposes one group containing exactly issues 101 and 102 (CSV export feature and its tests).
Proposes no other group: 103 and 104 are not grouped with anything.
The rationale for the 101/102 group says they are the same piece of work (the feature and the tests for that feature), not merely the same area.
